name: shipd-fastlane
description: Shipd artifact delivery workflow distilled from accepted cases and iteration history, with mandatory local quality evidence before upload, coverage checks and usage checkpoints.

interface.shortDescription: Fewer Shipd review cycles; faster proven artifacts.
interface.longDescription: A stage-specific companion to Olympus Forge with historical accepted patterns, 195 searchable lesson records, mandatory local quality evidence before upload, public-contract coverage checks, artifact staleness tracking, remote runtime guidance and usage checkpoints.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Shipd Fastlane and WORKFLOW.md to resume this case at its first unproven stage. Prove feasibility, map every requirement, build the stage-appropriate artifacts, validate applicable local gates on shipd-local, and deliver exact artifacts with evidence. Honor this task's usage and thermal policies. No paid Shipd gate without explicit authorization.
